witness_description: No concrete Hom_p(F,K_n) witness is certified. The first abstract ambiguity model has two vertices, no C-edge, one putative strong edge, and colors (0,0), but the quote does not establish that this model comes from Hom_p(F,K_n).
refutation_explanation: The quote states unequal colors for pairs connected in C and then concludes properness for \widetilde C, but it supplies neither definitions of Hom_p and its vertices nor a definition of strong compatibility adjacency nor the relation between C and \widetilde C. Consequently the bounded relational model can expose the missing bridge but cannot be promoted to a mathematical counterexample.
search_space: Exhaustively swept 1,745 abstract labeled interpretations: for each vertex count n in {1,2,3}, every simple undirected C graph, every independent simple undirected putative-strong graph, and every coloring into {0,...,n-1}; totals are 1 + 16 + 1,728 = 1,745. These are logical test models, not an exhaustive space of Hom_p(F,K_n) instances.
